# 工作流 Reference

本文件由 `pilot/ascendc_pilot/workflows/specs.py`（经 registry normalize）生成，请不要手工编辑。

`Action 执行` 来自各 Action 的 `execution_mode` / `agent_id`；`Workflow Agents` 是 workflow 声明的身份清单（含 Primary），**不是**逐步执行者。

| 工作流 | 入口 | 状态 | Action | Action 执行 | Workflow Agents | Gate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uo-init` | `/uo-init` | prepare, heal, extract, analyze, commit, verify | prepare, propose_include_heal, heal_promote, extract, analyze, commit, verify | `prepare`:deterministic<br>`propose_include_heal`:subagent(`uo-heal-analyst`)<br>`heal_promote`:deterministic<br>`extract`:deterministic<br>`analyze`:deterministic<br>`commit`:deterministic<br>`verify`:deterministic | `ascendc-pilot`, `uo-heal-analyst`, `deterministic-uo-engine` | layout_receipt, scope_receipt, extract_receipt, uo_product_ready, integrity |
| `uo-update` | `/uo-update` | detect, plan, apply, export, diff | detect_changes, plan_update, apply_update, export_integrity, diff_summary, diff_only | `detect_changes`:deterministic<br>`plan_update`:deterministic<br>`apply_update`:deterministic<br>`export_integrity`:deterministic<br>`diff_summary`:deterministic<br>`diff_only`:deterministic | `deterministic-uo-engine` | integrity |
| `uo-query` | `/uo-query` | answer | kb_lookup | `kb_lookup`:subagent(`uo-query`) | `uo-query` |  |
| `uo-investigate` | `/uo-investigate` | investigate, report | investigate | `investigate`:subagent(`uo-gap-investigator`) | `uo-gap-investigator`, `ascendc-pilot` |  |
| `tg-init` | `/tg-init` | kb_ready, scan, bind, validate | kb_check, repo_scan, bind_init, bind_review, bind_promote, validate_init | `kb_check`:deterministic<br>`repo_scan`:deterministic<br>`bind_init`:subagent(`tg-analyst`)<br>`bind_review`:primary_review(`ascendc-pilot`)<br>`bind_promote`:deterministic<br>`validate_init`:deterministic | `deterministic-tg-engine`, `tg-analyst`, `ascendc-pilot` | uo_ready, init_confirmed, kb_fingerprint_fresh |
| `tg-plan` | `/tg-plan` | gate, scope, fuse, validate, approve | plan_precheck, plan_scope, plan_fuse, plan_promote, plan_validate, plan_approve | `plan_precheck`:deterministic<br>`plan_scope`:subagent(`tg-analyst`)<br>`plan_fuse`:subagent(`tg-analyst`)<br>`plan_promote`:deterministic<br>`plan_validate`:deterministic<br>`plan_approve`:primary_interactive(`ascendc-pilot`) | `deterministic-tg-engine`, `tg-analyst`, `ascendc-pilot` | tg_init_confirmed, kb_fingerprint_fresh, plan_approved |
| `tg-solve` | `/tg-solve` | gate, construct, replay, analyze, certify | solve_precheck, construct_cases, construct_promote, replay_round, analyze_round, analyze_promote, solve_certify | `solve_precheck`:deterministic<br>`construct_cases`:subagent(`tg-analyst`)<br>`construct_promote`:deterministic<br>`replay_round`:deterministic<br>`analyze_round`:subagent(`tg-analyst`)<br>`analyze_promote`:deterministic<br>`solve_certify`:deterministic | `deterministic-tg-engine`, `tg-analyst`, `ascendc-pilot` | plan_approved, kb_fingerprint_fresh, test_harness_gap_cleared, worklog_closed |
| `ce-plan` | `/ce-plan` | kb_ready, grill, draft, confirm | kb_check, intent_grill, grill_promote, grill_confirm, plan_draft, human_confirm | `kb_check`:deterministic<br>`intent_grill`:subagent(`ce-analyst`)<br>`grill_promote`:deterministic<br>`grill_confirm`:primary_interactive(`ascendc-pilot`)<br>`plan_draft`:subagent(`ce-analyst`)<br>`human_confirm`:primary_interactive(`ascendc-pilot`) | `deterministic-ce-engine`, `ce-analyst`, `ascendc-pilot` | kb_ready |
| `ce-apply` | `/ce-apply` | gate, patch, guard, refresh, report, revise | apply_gate, patch, patch_guard, codemap_refresh, apply_report, plan_revise, plan_revise_check | `apply_gate`:deterministic<br>`patch`:subagent(`ce-applier`)<br>`patch_guard`:deterministic<br>`codemap_refresh`:deterministic<br>`apply_report`:primary_interactive(`ascendc-pilot`)<br>`plan_revise`:subagent(`ce-analyst`)<br>`plan_revise_check`:deterministic | `deterministic-ce-engine`, `ce-applier`, `ce-analyst`, `ascendc-pilot` |  |
| `ce-review` | `/ce-review` | scope, review, summary | change_capture, code_review, review_report | `change_capture`:deterministic<br>`code_review`:subagent(`ce-reviewer`)<br>`review_report`:primary_interactive(`ascendc-pilot`) | `deterministic-ce-engine`, `ce-reviewer`, `ascendc-pilot` | kb_ready, context_pack |
| `handoff` | `/handoff` | session | session_handoff | `session_handoff`:subagent(`ce-analyst`) | `ce-analyst`, `ascendc-pilot` |  |
| `auto` | 内部（无 Slash 入口） |  |  |  |  |  |
| `goal-intake` | 内部（无 Slash 入口） | promote | intent_promote | `intent_promote`:deterministic | `deterministic-tg-engine`, `ascendc-pilot` |  |
